## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical change.

## Verification

- [ ] `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug`
- [ ] Tested on a device or emulator when behavior changed

## Safety

- [ ] No API keys, account data, machine names, private repositories, or signed APKs are included
- [ ] New API calls and undocumented endpoints are documented
- [ ] Privacy, security, permissions, and background-network effects were considered
- [ ] The change does not imply affiliation with Anysphere
